english.title: Fail to deliver a thing detained / seized as liable to forfeiture at Customs and Excise Office
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), not being an officer and having

(A)_[seized]_
(B)_[detained]_

something liable to forfeiture under the Customs and Excise Acts, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING SEIZED / DETAINED..),

(C)_[failed to deliver it to the nearest convenient office of customs and excise]_
(D)_[and it not being practicable to deliver it to the nearest convenient office of customs and excise, failed to give to the Commissioners at that office notice in writing of the seizure with full particulars of the thing seized]_
(E)_[and it not being practicable to deliver it to the nearest convenient office of customs and excise, failed to give the Commissioners at that office notice in writing of the detention with full particulars of the thing detained]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 139(2) and (7) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Methu danfon gwrthrych a gadwyd / atafaelwyd am ei fod yn agored i'w fforffedu i'r Swyddfa Tollau Tramor a Chartref

(B)_[gadw]_
